editor.title: Session editor
editor.subtitle: Change the data without touching the original Pokédex.
editor.noSessionHint: Global data is never edited. Create or pick a session and every change is stored inside it.
editor.hints.sprite: Image path or URL. File uploads arrive in Phase 9.
editor.hints.emptyIsNone: Leave empty if it doesn't apply.
editor.error.dex: The Pokédex number must be greater than 0.
editor.error.typesRepeated: The two types can't be the same.
editor.relations.hint: Tap a cell to cycle x0 → x0.25 → x0.5 → x1 → x2 → x4. Rows attack, columns defend.
editor.relations.caption: Effectiveness table: the row type attacks the column type.
theme.hint: Give this session its own look. Pure black (#000000) isn't allowed: on OLED screens it smears when content moves.
theme.error.black: Pure black isn't allowed. Try a very dark blue, like #0A1425.
theme.warning.nearBlack: Almost black: OLED smearing may still show.
theme.preview.title: Preview
theme.preview.body: This is how the app's secondary text will look.
data.title: Import and export
data.subtitle: Get your PamuDeX data out as JSON or CSV, from the global dataset or a specific session.
data.loadError: Sessions could not be loaded. You can still export the global dataset.
data.globalHint: The original Pokédex, without any session's changes.
data.sessionHint: The data with the changes from “{{name}}” already applied.
data.jsonHint: A single file with types, type chart, Pokémon, moves and abilities. Same format as the seed files: drop it in backend/data/ and run the seed to rebuild this very database.
data.csvHint: One file per entity, with a header row and quoting where needed. They open straight in LibreOffice or Excel.
data.sqliteHint: A self-contained .sqlite file with the full schema and the data already resolved. If you export a session, its changes come applied in the rows themselves. Opens in any SQLite viewer.
data.importIntoGlobal: The file will be applied to the global dataset. Upload a JSON, a CSV or a .sqlite.
data.importIntoSession: The file will be applied as this session's changes, leaving the global data untouched.
data.mode.mergeHint: Updates what matches and keeps everything else.
data.replaceWarnGlobal: You are about to delete every Pokémon, move, ability and type not present in the file. Your sessions and profiles are untouched, but the global data is not. This cannot be undone.
data.replaceWarnSession: Any changes this session already had will be discarded, leaving only the file's. This cannot be undone.
data.replaceConfirm: I understand and want to replace
data.noChanges: No changes: the file matches what is already there.
data.errorsFound: {{n}} validation error(s). Fix the file: it cannot be applied like this.
data.genericError: The file could not be processed.
data.err.no_es_sqlite: The file is not a SQLite database.
data.err.esquema_incompatible: The SQLite file does not have the schema PamuDeX expects.
data.err.sqlite_ilegible: The SQLite file could not be read.
data.err.entidad_invalida: Say which entity the file corresponds to.
